name: Miryokuteki na Senpai to Kouhai ni Furikai Sareru Boku ~Kyonyuu to Bishiri Hasamarete Taihen Desu~
original_name: 魅力的な先輩と後輩に振り回されるボク ～巨乳と美尻に挟まれて大変です～
source:
Until two years ago, Kinohana Academy was an all-girls school.

There were only a few male students in the entire school in this year, and the student council consisted of only three members.

The protagonist, Mogusa Haruto, who was in charge of odd jobs, was enjoying peaceful student council activities with Konohana Saori, the spoiled and somewhat out-of-control student council president, and Iwanaga Tomomi, the shy secretary. 

One day, a request letter arrived at the student council. It was a consultation about "first time having sex", and that changed everything. 

"We, the student council, will answer all of your naughty questions. To do so, we will be practicing naughty acts. So, we'll need your full cooperation, Haruto." 

Haruto was more flustered than ever before, and the most bewildered. 
The president's hand reached out to his belt and of course, Haruto got caught up in it.

Secretary Tomomi blushed and froze. 
And President Saori was surprisingly enthusiastic.

And so, the first step in student council activities, which no one could stop, was taken.

[Edited from [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item282667]Gyutto[/url]]
translation:
直到两年前，木之花学院还是一所女子学校。

今年全校男学生只有寥寥几个，学生会成员也只有三人。

负责打零工的主人公茂草晴人，与被宠坏的、有些失控的学生会会长木花纱织、害羞的秘书岩永朋美一起，享受着平静的学生会活动。

有一天，一封请求信到达了学生会。这是一次关于“第一次做爱”的咨询，这改变了一切。

“我们学生会会回答你所有顽皮的问题。为此，我们将练习顽皮的行为。所以，我们需要你的全力配合，Haruto。” 

春人比以往任何时候都更加慌乱，也更加困惑。
社长的手伸到了腰带上，春人当然也被卷住了。

友美秘书脸红了，僵住了。
沙织社长出奇地热情。

就这样，谁都无法阻止的学生会活动的第一步就开始了。
